refusal.cause: PAL StreamSoundTrigger has no sound-model platform entry for vendor UUID 9f6ad62a-1f0b-11e7-87c5-40a8f03d3f15. The resource-manager XML on this device declares QC Voice UI, Google hotword, QC ACD, sensor PCM and MMA stream configs only; the Snapdragon Pixels that ship this model declare a Google Music Detection config whose execution_type is ADSP with library "none", i.e. a Google module inside the Pixel ADSP image this device does not carry.
refusal.side_effect: Each failed load rebooted the sound-trigger HAL, which restarted audioserver and the QTI audio HAL; ASI retried every 5 s, so the audio HAL restarted every 5 s while the setting was on.
refusal.left_as: Now Playing turned back off through ASI's own switch after the measurement; the audio HAL was then stable and no further load attempts were logged.

retained_userdata.note: Retention is structural: the eight-image write set contained no userdata or metadata partition and no wipe was requested.
